title: E1 Listening for Numbers, Days, Times and Prices – Lesson Audio

scripts.label: Script A – Tuesday or Thursday? Six sentences (no worksheet – learners show 2 or 4 fingers)
lines: Number one. The class is on Tuesday.
Number two. The doctor is on Thursday.
Number three. I go to the market on Thursday.
Number four. The bus is late on Tuesday.
Number five. My birthday is on Tuesday.
Number six. We play football on Thursday.
questions: 1 Tuesday · 2 Thursday · 3 Thursday · 4 Tuesday · 5 Tuesday · 6 Thursday

scripts.label: Script B – Prices (Handout Section B)
lines: Number one. Two pounds. … Two pounds.
Number two. One pound fifty. … One pound fifty.
Number three. Ninety p. … Ninety p.
Number four. Three pounds twenty. … Three pounds twenty.
Number five. Fifty p. … Fifty p.
Number six. Ten pounds. … Ten pounds.

scripts.label: Script C – Doctor's surgery message (Handout Sections C and D)
lines: Hello. This is the doctor's surgery. Your appointment is on Tuesday at ten o'clock. Thank you.
questions: Is the appointment on Monday? (No, it isn't.)
What time is the appointment? (Ten o'clock.)

scripts.label: Script D – At the shop (Handout Sections C and D)
questions: Is the bread two pounds? (No, it isn't.)
How much is the milk? (Ninety p.)

scripts.label: Script E – My English class (exam practice – no writing)
lines: My English class is on Monday and Thursday. It starts at half past nine. It finishes at twelve o'clock.
questions: Is the class on Thursday? (Yes, it is.)
What time does it start? (Half past nine.)

scripts.label: Script F – The bus (exam practice – no writing)
questions: Is it bus number five? (No, it isn't.)
What time is the bus? (Four o'clock.)

scripts.label: Script G – The swimming class (Copy and complete slide on the projector)
lines: Hello. What day is the swimming class?
It starts at half past six.
It's four pounds fifty for adults and two pounds for children.
Is there a class on Saturday too?
Yes. It starts at ten o'clock.
questions: 1 Thursday · 2 time · 3 half · 4 seven · 5 How · 6 £4.50 · 7 pounds · 8 o'clock
